title: Annotatio V §.X: prior reply — Indignorum error need not block discretio if Spiritual eating intact
pass_a_gloss: When, to blunt this, I had warned that not every error about the Holy Supper — e.g. error about the Eating of the Unworthy — impedes worthy discernment of Christ’s body, so long as Spiritual Eating remains untainted, which could also be given, and actually is given, even outside the Sacrament of the Supper.
pass_b_english: Strimesius had already answered: not every Supper error blocks that discernment — for example, error about the unworthy eating.
So long as Spiritual Eating stays sound, discernment can stand; and Spiritual Eating can be given, and is given, even outside the Supper sacrament.
source_text: Huic retundendæ cùm monuissem, non quemvis errorem de S. Cœna, e. g. errorem circa Indignorum Manducationem, dignam corporis Christi discretionem impedire, dummodo intemerata maneat Spiritualis Manducatio, quæ etiam, extra Sacramentum Cœnæ, dari posset, & actu daretur.
notes: Prior retund: Indignorum vs Spiritual eating.
